856-3899-5776-6277.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and On Wings of Gold trigger.
Resolve the On Wings of Gold trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

950-2645-3430-7069.easyPrerequisites:
You control an untapped land.
Fatestitcher doesn't have summoning sickness.
950-2645-3430-7069.description:
Activate a land by using the land granted to it by Tectonic Split by tapping it, adding nine mana of any color due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Fatestitcher.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

573-2026-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Voyaging Satyr doesn't have summoning sickness.
573-2026-2645-3430.description:
Activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{R}{R}{G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Gruul Turf
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1810-4881-6909.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{U} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
1810-4881-6909.description:
Cast Cackling Counterpart by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with six or more phyresis counters on it

1339-3394-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-3394-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Weatherlight Compleated triggers, putting a phyresis counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

2073-5315-7876-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Consulate Dreadnought from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Consulate Dreadnought enters, Kolodin triggers, causing Consulate Dreadnought to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Consulate Dreadnought.
When Consulate Dreadnought dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

549-4186-6830-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
549-4186-6830-6996.description:
Gain life in any way.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

997-1263-3220-4871.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2204-3967-6972.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Scholar of New Horizons.
When Scholar of New Horizons dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

341-3532-5078-7736.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Shang-Chi and the Ten Rings triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

112-676-4050-7639.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creature tokens.
112-676-4050-7639.description:
Cast Clockspinning by paying {U} due to Magnus the Red.
Namor triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve Clockspinning.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk, adding {U}.
Repeat.

3944-5220-6772-6900.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Syr Vondam trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and putting a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2173-5220-5708-6505.description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mortuary and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

560-1563-3899-5223.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

57-4846-6657-6968.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-4846-6657-6968.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-2811-3490-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-2811-3490-4659.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing each opponent to lose life.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

1350-4377-6333-6678.manaNeeded: {5}{W} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
1350-4377-6333-6678.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Talon Gates of Madara by paying {4}, putting it from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Talon Gates of Madara enters the battlefield, it triggers, phasing out Hades.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Talon Gates of Madara by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Talon Gates of Madara from the battlefield to your hand.
During your extra turn, Hades phases in during your untap step.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4550-5042-5147-5567--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
4550-5042-5147-5567--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1558-3529-4231-6558.notablePrerequisites:
Naga Fleshcrafter is a copy of Academy Manufactor.
Hoard Robber does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by at least one opponent.
1558-3529-4231-6558.description:
Attack with Hoard Robber.
Hoard Robber triggers on combat damage to a player, creating three Treasure tokens, three Food tokens, and three Clue tokens.
Activate Time Sieve's ability by tapping Time Sieve and sacrificing five artifacts you control, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3174-5231-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Switcheroo.
3174-5231-5434-5555.description:
Cast Switcheroo by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Thermopod by sacrificing a face-down creature you control, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Repeat from step 2.

3603-5195-5913.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, targeting Pinnacle Monk
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Pinnacle Monk
When Pinnacle Monk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cloudshift to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

5473-5657-5665.description:
Cast Spawn-Gang Commander by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Ulalek triggers twice, and Spawn-Gang Commander triggers once.
Resolve one of Ulalek's triggers, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy the Spawn-Gang Commander spell, Ulalek's trigger and Spawn-Gang Commander's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Spawn-Gang Commander's trigger, creating three 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate two Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Ulalek trigger from step 3, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy the Spawn-Gang Commander spell, Ulalek's trigger and Spawn-Gang Commander's trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
5473-5657-5665.notes: Once you have infinite {C} and Eldrazi Spawn tokens, you may sacrifice them to Spawn-Gang Commander to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

2167-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
You control at least eight other mana-producing lands, three of which can tap to produce at least {G}.
2167-5720-5721.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland, adding {G} if possible, or one mana of any other type otherwise.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other mana-producing lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.
If you control nine or more other mana-producing lands, this combo will net infinite mana of colors those lands can produce.

2713-2797-5343.notablePrerequisites: Bigger on the Inside attached to Retrofitter Foundry.
2713-2797-5343.description:
Activate Retrofitter Foundry by tapping it, adding two mana of any color and causing the next spell you cast this turn to have cascade.
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Retrofitter Foundry's other abilities.

2146-2604-4489.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that has Morph or Megamorph.
"Creature" chosen with Cloud Key.
2146-2604-4489.description:
Cast the creature using its morph or megamorph cost by paying {0}, putting it face-down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
Activate Primordial Mist by exiling the face down creature face up, allowing you to cast it this turn.
Repeat.

369-2961-5256.notablePrerequisites: False Demise attached to Iridescent Drake.
369-2961-5256.description:
Sacrifice Iridescent Drake to Altar of Dementia.
False Demise returns Iridescent Drake to the battlefield.
Iridescent Drake returns False Demise to the battlefield attached to itself.
Repeat.

101-3617-4305.notablePrerequisites: Followed Footsteps attached to Vampire Charmseeker.
101-3617-4305.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying {1}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a token copy of Vampire Charmseeker.
The Vampire Charmseeker token enters the battlefield, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

391-1671-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Blossom Dryad does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Blossom Dryad.
391-1671-3525.description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {U}{G}.
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Blossom Dryad.
Repeat any number of times.

406-2353.notablePrerequisites:
Tandem Lookout paired with Niv-Mizzet.
You have a way to draw a card.
Your library is greater than opponent life total.
406-2353.description:
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Niv-Mizzet's soulbond ability triggers, drawing you a card.
Repeat from step 2.
